title: Complete ancestry and background character-creation choices
description:
Problem:
Ancestry and background records are mostly source-complete but still contain important character-creation choices in prose or partially structured form.

Known examples from the 2026-06-29 audit:
- ancestry:dragonborn has Draconic Ancestry table text but no structured persisted dragon type choice.
- dwarf / hill dwarf artisan tool choice is prose only.
- high elf wizard cantrip and extra language choices are prose or partial.
- half-elf Skill Versatility is prose only.
- background:acolyte has structured languages but equipment is prose, and personality/ideal/bond/flaw tables are linked rather than modeled as character-creation rolls/choices.

Implement:
- Add deterministic choices for ancestry/subrace/background decisions needed during character creation.
- Link choices to table refs where the source provides a table.
- Store selected values by stable ids or typed values.
- Keep source prose and source locations for auditability.
- Coordinate with starting equipment modeling for background equipment grants.

Acceptance criteria:
- Character creation can resolve Dragonborn draconic ancestry deterministically.
- Character creation can resolve ancestry tool, skill, cantrip, and language choices deterministically.
- Character creation can resolve background equipment and trait/ideal/bond/flaw selection or rolling workflows.
- Choice-coverage audit does not flag the known ancestry/background cases.
- Existing tests and pack verification pass.
